# Same-package comparators {#sec-comparators}

refund's own remedies for dependent residuals against REML + CL2 (`comparators/`, Gaussian M1; R = 200 with
common random numbers, REML estimates and SEs equal to the study's records). Cells: the six Gaussian core
cells (iid / OU / smooth errors × G = 40, 100, default signal) and twelve plasmode cells (the six datasets with
independent curves, log-midpoint truth, REML residuals, curve flips, all subjects and G = 40). Arms:

- REML model-based (V_c) and REML + CL2 (the study's arms);
- pcre: REML fit with a `pcre()` curve effect on the eigenfunctions of the REML residual curves (`fpca.sc`,
  pve 0.95), model-based V_c;
- GLS raw / GLS FPCA: the pre-deprecation `pffr_gls()` algorithm (refund's `pffrGLS()` only errors in the study
  build) with the residual covariance estimated by the raw covariance of the REML residual curves (refund's
  documented use) or by the FPCA covariance plus white noise; model-based V_c;
- curve bootstrap of the REML fit (resampling and refit as `pffr_coefboot()`, B = 199, replicates 1–100):
  percentile intervals and bootstrap-SE Wald intervals around the REML estimate.

Point estimates: pcre and both GLS arms have their own; the bootstrap arms use the REML estimate. NCV's
estimates for the same cells and replicates come from the study (`summaries/final/cells.csv`,
`summaries/plasmode/coverage.csv`). Relative error as in @sec-relerr, at the cell level: √(MSE / grid mean of the
squared truth), the truth centred for the mean and α(t).

```{r comp-load}
CMP <- readr::read_csv("comparators/summaries/comparators-cells.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
CMPF <- readr::read_csv("comparators/summaries/comparators-fits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
CMP_ARMS <- c(reml_model = "REML model-based", reml_cl2 = "REML + CL2", pcre = "pcre", gls_fpc = "GLS (FPCA cov.)",
              gls_raw = "GLS (raw cov.)", boot_pct = "bootstrap percentile", boot_wald = "bootstrap Wald")
# NCV estimates for the same cells (study records; same replicates by common random numbers)
ncv_syn <- S |> filter(cell %in% CMP$cell[CMP$source == "synthetic"], arm %in% c("ncv_cl2", "reml_cl2")) |>
  transmute(source = "synthetic", cell, estimand, arm, mse)
ncv_pm <- read_summary("plasmode", "coverage") |>
  filter(truth == "MID", residual == "REML", flip == "curve", error == "attached", arm %in% c("ncv_cl2", "reml_cl2")) |>
  select(app, G, estimand, arm, mse) |>
  inner_join(CMP |> filter(source == "plasmode") |> distinct(cell, app, G), by = c("app", "G")) |>
  transmute(source = "plasmode", cell, estimand, arm, mse)
# check: REML MSE identical in both sources
cmp_chk <- bind_rows(ncv_syn, ncv_pm) |> filter(arm == "reml_cl2") |>
  inner_join(CMP |> filter(arm == "reml_cl2") |> select(source, cell, estimand, mse_c = mse), by = c("source", "cell", "estimand"))
stopifnot(nrow(cmp_chk) > 0, max(abs(cmp_chk$mse / cmp_chk$mse_c - 1)) < 1e-6)
cmp_den <- bind_rows(
  read_summary("final", "relative-error") |> mutate(source = "synthetic"),
  read_summary("plasmode", "relative-error") |> mutate(source = "plasmode")
) |> distinct(source, cell, estimand, denom)
cmp_est_arms <- c(REML = "reml_cl2", NCV = "ncv_cl2", pcre = "pcre", `GLS (FPCA cov.)` = "gls_fpc", `GLS (raw cov.)` = "gls_raw")
CMP_EST <- bind_rows(
  CMP |> filter(arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "pcre", "gls_fpc", "gls_raw")) |> select(source, cell, estimand, arm, mse),
  bind_rows(ncv_syn, ncv_pm) |> filter(arm == "ncv_cl2")
) |>
  left_join(CMP |> distinct(source, cell, label, error, app, G), by = c("source", "cell")) |>
  left_join(cmp_den, by = c("source", "cell", "estimand")) |>
  mutate(rel = sqrt(mse / denom), fit = factor(names(cmp_est_arms)[match(arm, cmp_est_arms)], names(cmp_est_arms)),
         setting = case_when(source == "plasmode" ~ "plasmode", error == "iid" ~ "synthetic, independent", TRUE ~ "synthetic, dependent"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(CMP_EST$rel))
cmp_ratio <- CMP_EST |> group_by(source, cell, estimand) |>
  mutate(vs_REML = mse / mse[fit == "REML"], vs_NCV = mse / mse[fit == "NCV"]) |> ungroup()
cmp_er <- \(f, e, set, col = "vs_NCV") cmp_ratio[[col]][cmp_ratio$fit == f & cmp_ratio$estimand == e & cmp_ratio$setting == set]
cmp_cv <- \(a, e, set) {
  d <- CMP |> mutate(setting = case_when(source == "plasmode" ~ "plasmode", error == "iid" ~ "synthetic, independent", TRUE ~ "synthetic, dependent"))
  d$coverage[d$arm == a & d$estimand == e & d$setting == set]
}
```

```{r fig-comp-coverage}
#| fig-cap: "Same-package comparators: grid-averaged coverage per cell (points) by estimand and setting; dashed: nominal 0.95. Synthetic: Gaussian core cells (independent: iid; dependent: OU and smooth errors); plasmode: six datasets with independent curves, all subjects and G = 40."
#| fig-height: 5.5
d <- CMP |>
  mutate(setting = case_when(source == "plasmode" ~ "plasmode", error == "iid" ~ "synthetic, independent", TRUE ~ "synthetic, dependent"),
         arm = factor(CMP_ARMS[arm], rev(CMP_ARMS)), estimand = label_estimand(estimand))
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(coverage, arm)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, seed = 1), size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(estimand ~ setting) +
  labs(x = "coverage (grid average)", y = NULL) +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "comparators-coverage", 7, 5.5)
fig
```

```{r fig-comp-estimation}
#| fig-cap: "Point-estimate accuracy of the comparators relative to the NCV fit: MSE of each estimator divided by the NCV fit's MSE per cell (log scale; < 1 = better than NCV), by estimand and setting. REML is included for reference; the bootstrap arms use the REML estimate."
#| fig-height: 5
d <- cmp_ratio |> filter(fit != "NCV") |> mutate(estimand = label_estimand(estimand))
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(vs_NCV, fit)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, seed = 1), size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(estimand ~ setting) +
  labs(x = "MSE / MSE of the NCV fit (log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_doc
save_fig(fig, "comparators-estimation", 7, 5)
fig
```

```{r comp-tables}
comp_cov <- CMP |>
  mutate(setting = case_when(source == "plasmode" ~ "plasmode", error == "iid" ~ "synthetic, independent", TRUE ~ "synthetic, dependent")) |>
  group_by(setting, estimand, cell) |>
  mutate(width_rel = width / width[arm == "reml_cl2"], score_rel = score / score[arm == "reml_cl2"]) |>
  group_by(setting, estimand, arm) |>
  summarise(cells = n(), coverage_min = min(coverage), coverage = mean(coverage), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05),
            width_rel = exp(mean(log(width_rel))), score_rel = exp(mean(log(score_rel))), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(arm = factor(CMP_ARMS[arm], CMP_ARMS), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  select(setting, estimand, arm, cells, coverage, coverage_min, q05, width_rel, score_rel) |>
  arrange(setting, estimand, arm)
save_tab(comp_cov, "comparators-coverage")
comp_est <- cmp_ratio |>
  group_by(setting, estimand, fit) |>
  summarise(cells = n(), rel_error = median(rel), mse_vs_REML = exp(mean(log(vs_REML))),
            vs_NCV_min = min(vs_NCV), vs_NCV_max = max(vs_NCV), mse_vs_NCV = exp(mean(log(vs_NCV))), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  arrange(setting, estimand, fit)
save_tab(comp_est, "comparators-estimation")
comp_est_pm <- cmp_ratio |> filter(source == "plasmode", estimand == "beta") |>
  select(app, G, fit, rel) |> pivot_wider(names_from = fit, values_from = rel) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |> arrange(app, desc(G))
save_tab(comp_est_pm, "comparators-estimation-plasmode-beta")
comp_time <- CMPF |> group_by(arm) |> summarise(median_s = median(time), q90_s = unname(quantile(time, 0.9)), .groups = "drop")
save_tab(comp_time, "comparators-time")
cmp_gm <- \(x) exp(mean(log(x)))
```

**Coverage.** Under dependent synthetic errors pcre and GLS with the FPCA covariance cover β at
`r rng(cmp_cv("pcre", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))` and `r rng(cmp_cv("gls_fpc", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))`,
REML + CL2 at `r rng(cmp_cv("reml_cl2", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))`. On the plasmode cells, with real residual
curves, they fall to `r rng(cmp_cv("pcre", "beta", "plasmode"))` and `r rng(cmp_cv("gls_fpc", "beta", "plasmode"))`
while REML + CL2 stays at `r rng(cmp_cv("reml_cl2", "beta", "plasmode"))` (@fig-comp-coverage, @tbl-comp-coverage).
GLS with the raw residual covariance, refund's documented use, undercovers everywhere (β
`r rng(cmp_cv("gls_raw", "beta", "synthetic, independent"))` even under independent errors). pcre's intervals for
α(t) cover at `r rng(cmp_cv("pcre", "alpha", "synthetic, dependent"))` under dependent synthetic errors. The curve
bootstrap covers β at `r rng(cmp_cv("boot_pct", "beta", "plasmode"))` (percentile, plasmode) with intervals
`r f(cmp_gm(comp_cov$width_rel[comp_cov$arm == CMP_ARMS[["boot_pct"]] & comp_cov$estimand == label_estimand("beta") & comp_cov$setting == "plasmode"]), 2)`
times as wide as REML + CL2's, at a median of `r f(comp_time$median_s[comp_time$arm == "BOOT"], 0)` s per replicate
against `r f(comp_time$median_s[comp_time$arm == "REML"], 1)` s for the REML fit.

**Point estimates.** Relative to the NCV fit, the β MSE of pcre and of GLS (FPCA covariance) is
`r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))` and `r rng(cmp_er("GLS (FPCA cov.)", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))`
times NCV's under dependent synthetic errors, REML's `r rng(cmp_er("REML", "beta", "synthetic, dependent"))` times
(@fig-comp-estimation, @tbl-comp-estimation): both remedies remove most of REML's excess error but stay
`r if (all(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "synthetic, dependent") > 1)) "above" else "around"` NCV's. On the plasmode cells
the ratios are `r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "plasmode"))` (pcre) and `r rng(cmp_er("GLS (FPCA cov.)", "beta", "plasmode"))`
(GLS FPCA), against `r rng(cmp_er("REML", "beta", "plasmode"))` for REML; pcre's MSE is below NCV's in
`r sum(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "plasmode") < 1)` of `r length(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "plasmode"))` cells. For the mean the
ratios of pcre to NCV are `r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "mean", "synthetic, dependent"))` (synthetic dependent) and
`r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "mean", "plasmode"))` (plasmode); for γ(t) `r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "gamma", "synthetic, dependent"))` and
`r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "gamma", "plasmode"))`; for α(t) `r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "alpha", "synthetic, dependent"))` and
`r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "alpha", "plasmode"))`. Under independent errors pcre and GLS (FPCA) estimate β like the REML fit
(MSE `r rng(cmp_er("pcre", "beta", "synthetic, independent", "vs_REML"))` and
`r rng(cmp_er("GLS (FPCA cov.)", "beta", "synthetic, independent", "vs_REML"))` times REML's), and NCV
`r rng(cmp_er("NCV", "beta", "synthetic, independent", "vs_REML"))` times. Relative errors of β per plasmode cell are in
@tbl-comp-est-pm.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-comp-coverage
#| tbl-cap: "Same-package comparators: mean and minimum coverage over cells, mean 5% pointwise quantile, and width and interval score relative to REML + CL2 (geometric means of per-cell ratios), by setting, estimand and arm."
show(comp_cov |> mutate(setting = recode(setting, `synthetic, dependent` = "syn. dep.", `synthetic, independent` = "syn. iid")), digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-comp-estimation
#| tbl-cap: "Point-estimate accuracy: median relative error over cells, and MSE relative to REML and to the NCV fit (geometric mean of per-cell ratios; range for NCV), by setting, estimand and estimator. The bootstrap arms share the REML estimate."
show(comp_est |> mutate(setting = recode(setting, `synthetic, dependent` = "syn. dep.", `synthetic, independent` = "syn. iid")), digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-comp-est-pm
#| tbl-cap: "Relative error of the β estimate per plasmode comparator cell (log-midpoint truth, REML residuals; all subjects and G = 40)."
show(comp_est_pm, digits = 2)
```

Comparator run details (bootstrap on replicates 1–100; the GLS algorithm rebuilt from refund's internals, with
the documented nearPD repair because refund's `compute_sqrt_sigma_inv()` returns NaN for a singular residual
covariance; two failed bootstrap rows in DTI at G = 40, kept; time per arm in `comparators-time.csv`):
`comparators/summaries/SUMMARY.md`.

## CL2 on the GLS and pcre fits {#sec-comp-cl2}

GLS whitens each curve with Σ̂^{-1/2}; the transform acts within curves, so curves stay independent clusters and
CL2 (Bayesian form, curves as clusters) applies to the whitened fit, valid even if Σ̂ is wrong. pcre + CL2 is CL2 on
the pcre fit. Same cells and replicates as above; shown here for replicates 1–100, where all arms exist
(`comparators/summaries/cl2-arms-cells.csv`, `cl2-arms-SUMMARY.md`: CL2 on the whitened fit reproduces refund's
`pffr_vcov()` construction and a direct dense computation to ~1e-10; one pcre + CL2 replicate failed in the SVD
and is excluded for that arm only).

```{r cl2arms}
CA <- readr::read_csv("comparators/summaries/cl2-arms-cells.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(window == "1-100") |>
  mutate(setting = case_when(source == "plasmode" ~ "plasmode", error == "iid" ~ "synthetic, independent", TRUE ~ "synthetic, dependent"))
CA_ARMS <- c(reml_cl2 = "REML + CL2", ncv_cl2 = "NCV + CL2", gls_fpc = "GLS (FPCA cov.)", gls_fpc_cl2 = "GLS (FPCA cov.) + CL2",
             gls_raw_cl2 = "GLS (raw cov.) + CL2", pcre = "pcre", pcre_cl2 = "pcre + CL2")
ca_tab <- CA |> filter(arm %in% names(CA_ARMS)) |>
  group_by(setting, estimand, cell) |>
  mutate(width_rel = width / width[arm == "reml_cl2"], score_rel = score / score[arm == "reml_cl2"],
         mse_vs_NCV = mse / mse[arm == "ncv_cl2"]) |>
  group_by(setting, estimand, arm) |>
  summarise(cov_min = min(coverage), coverage = mean(coverage), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), width_rel = exp(mean(log(width_rel))),
            score_rel = exp(mean(log(score_rel))), mse_vs_NCV = exp(mean(log(mse_vs_NCV))), detection = mean(detection), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(arm = factor(CA_ARMS[arm], CA_ARMS), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  select(setting, estimand, arm, coverage, cov_min, q05, width_rel, score_rel, mse_vs_NCV, detection) |>
  arrange(setting, estimand, arm)
save_tab(ca_tab, "comparators-cl2-arms")
cav <- \(a, set, col = "coverage", e = "beta") ca_tab[[col]][ca_tab$arm == CA_ARMS[[a]] & ca_tab$setting == set & ca_tab$estimand == label_estimand(e)]
ca_pm_app <- CA |> filter(source == "plasmode", estimand == "beta", arm == "gls_fpc_cl2") |>
  group_by(app) |> summarise(v = mean(coverage), .groups = "drop")
```

Under dependent synthetic errors GLS (FPCA covariance) + CL2 covers β at `r f(cav("gls_fpc_cl2", "synthetic, dependent"), 3)`
at `r f(cav("gls_fpc_cl2", "synthetic, dependent", "width_rel"), 2)` times REML + CL2's width (interval score
`r f(cav("gls_fpc_cl2", "synthetic, dependent", "score_rel"), 2)` times). On the plasmode cells it covers β at
`r f(cav("gls_fpc_cl2", "plasmode"), 3)` (per dataset `r rng(ca_pm_app$v)`; plain GLS `r f(cav("gls_fpc", "plasmode"), 3)`,
REML + CL2 `r f(cav("reml_cl2", "plasmode"), 3)`) at `r f(cav("gls_fpc_cl2", "plasmode", "width_rel"), 2)` times the
width; its SE matches the spread of the GLS estimate there (`cl2-arms-SUMMARY.md`), so the remaining shortfall is
bias of the GLS estimate on real residual curves. pcre + CL2 behaves alike (β `r f(cav("pcre_cl2", "plasmode"), 3)`)
and repairs pcre's α intervals on synthetic data (`r f(cav("pcre", "synthetic, dependent", "coverage", "alpha"), 2)` →
`r f(cav("pcre_cl2", "synthetic, dependent", "coverage", "alpha"), 2)`). GLS with the raw residual covariance + CL2
fails (`r f(cav("gls_raw_cl2", "synthetic, dependent"), 2)` under dependent synthetic errors): with more grid points
than curves, Σ̂ absorbs the residuals themselves.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-comp-cl2
#| tbl-cap: "CL2 on the GLS and pcre fits (replicates 1–100): mean and minimum coverage over cells, 5% pointwise quantile, width and interval score relative to REML + CL2, MSE relative to the NCV fit, detection rate, by setting, estimand and construction."
show(ca_tab |> mutate(setting = recode(setting, `synthetic, dependent` = "syn. dep.", `synthetic, independent` = "syn. iid")), digits = 2)
```
